DAILY · DAY 1

HOW TO DIE PROPERLY

You are already dead. This is what is left of you: a flame, going out. Everyone here is going out.
Be the last one to go.

Run into the spikes.
They are not hazards. They are the only fuel left.
Flame is time, at a worse and worse rate.
Your first 10 flame buy about 7 seconds. Your tenth 10 buy about 2. The brighter you burn, the more you pay per second alive — watch the rate climb as you eat.
The dim eat the bright.
Touch a brighter soul and you tear the flame straight out of it — and a third of it is lost to the dark on the way. Being the biggest fire here makes you food.
The light is closing.
Outside it, the void strips your flame away. Speed comes from flame, so don't get caught slow and far.
Tap to dash.
It costs flame. You are spending life to move — that is the deal here.
You cannot win without dying.
The match ends when the last soul goes out. Make sure that soul is you. There is a LET GO button in the corner that ends you instantly. It is not a trick. Not pressing it is the game.
